1.explanation: We import Carbon’s CodeSnippet and render it with type="multi" inside a 400px-wide div. We feed it one long unbroken string (the CRN). The default behavior is to render it as a block with overflow-x auto, so it never wraps and shows a horizontal scrollbar. This minimal example reproduces exactly the bug seen in your screenshot.
1.bug_scenario: When you render a CodeSnippet of type="multi" containing one very long unbroken string (for example a CRN) inside a constrained container width, the snippet does not wrap to new lines. Instead you get a horizontal scroll bar (as shown in the screenshot) and the text stays on one line.
